QuestInfo.name: Giants of the Cold Flame
QuestInfo.0: Find out what Grendel the Really Old discovered.
QuestInfo.1: The first paradox is the Flaming Mixed Golem's core. #bDouble-click on the #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern#k Grendel gave you to move to #m100040300# and put out #b50 Flaming Mixed Golems#k. When you're done, #bdouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k again to return.
QuestInfo.2: You added the Cold Flames to the Vampiric Lantern after defeating the Flaming Mixed Golems.

0.0: The cold flame is obvious enough. Head to the Golem's Temple south of here and find the burning golems. You can start a fire using their cores, but they feel cool to the touch.\r\n#L0##bHow peculiar! I wonder if all the paradoxes are related to monsters.#l\n#k
0.1: You're probably right. Anyway, head to the Golem's Temple. I'll look into the other paradoxes in the meantime.

yes.0: Take this #i2430873# #bVampiric Lantern#k that gathers light. Double-click on it to move to Golem's Temple and put out #b50 Flaming Mixed Golem#k. The energy of that light will be stored in the lantern. Don't forget to use the lantern to return.

no.0: You do want to find your way to Harmony, don't you?

1.0: You get all of that sweet golem light?\r\n#L0##bIndeed.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, yes. Feel the cold flame in that lantern? Perfect.

mob.0: You'll need to defeat more Flaming Mixed Golems before we can move on.
